supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: observable lateral extension beyond the outer eye margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: light-colored muzzle area exhibiting high contrast against darker, high-melanin periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip visible in a neutral position

other_distinctive_markers: prominent vertical white/light-colored hair patch or blaze centered on the mid-forehead and extending towards the crown
